statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-49267 (GHSA-799x-qp47-8qwq): Apache Airflow's email helpers in airflow.utils.email called smtplib's starttls() without an SSL context, so with smtp_starttls enabled and smtp_ssl disabled the STARTTLS upgrade did not verify the SMTP server's certificate, and a man in the middle could capture the SMTP credentials and messages. It is fixed in apache-airflow 3.2.2. The fix, https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/65346, passes an SSL context to starttls() in airflow-core's airflow/utils/email.py (send_mime_email, through a new _get_ssl_context helper) and in the SMTP provider's SmtpHook (airflow/providers/smtp/hooks/smtp.py, through a new _build_ssl_context helper, for both the sync and async clients). The SmtpHook half is also tracked as CVE-2026-41016, fixed in apache-airflow-providers-smtp 3.0.0 (GHSA-x8mh-94wc-33gv). The PyPI advisory record PYSEC-2026-4396 lists this CVE against apache-airflow-providers-smtp below 3.2.2, which is the apache-airflow core version, and that is why the provider versions in this package match. Sources: https://lists.apache.org/thread/6v2ds757000msmjmovnnqryqzks83ps0, https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-799x-qp47-8qwq, https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-x8mh-94wc-33gv. Every published airflow package carries the fix. We read every airflow package in the DHI Debian repository, 52 builds from 3.3.0-0 to 3.4.0-11, for amd64 and arm64, each checked against the SHA256 in the package index; no debug-symbol packages are published for it. Builds 3.3.0-0 to 3.3.2-19 ship apache-airflow and apache-airflow-core 3.3.0, 3.3.1 or 3.3.2 with apache-airflow-providers-smtp 3.0.1, 3.0.3 or 3.0.4, and builds 3.4.0-0 to 3.4.0-11 ship apache-airflow 3.4.0 with apache-airflow-providers-smtp 3.2.0, all from their dist-info metadata. In builds 3.3.0-0 to 3.3.2-19, airflow/utils/email.py calls smtp_conn.starttls(context=_get_ssl_context()). In builds 3.4.0-0 to 3.4.0-11, airflow/utils/email.py is a deprecation shim that re-exports send_mime_email and the other helpers from airflow/providers/smtp/utils/emailer.py, which calls smtp_conn.starttls(context=_get_ssl_context()). In every build, airflow/providers/smtp/hooks/smtp.py calls starttls(context=self._build_ssl_context()) on the sync client and starttls(tls_context=self._build_ssl_context()) on the async client. No other Airflow module in any build calls starttls(); the other calls in the packages are in the aiosmtplib library itself and, from 3.4.0-1, in litellm's proxy, which passes ssl.create_default_context(). The four wheel and jar archives bundled from 3.4.0-1 on (ray's two jars and virtualenv's embedded pip and setuptools wheels) were searched as well and hold no Airflow email or SMTP code. As with the upstream fix, setting [email] ssl_context or the SMTP connection's ssl_context extra to none still turns certificate checking off on purpose. 3.3.0-0 is the lowest published build, so every published build is on the fixed side.
